texts.en:
The Hyacinth's long-range receivers have intercepted a broadcast on Ulysses Initiative emergency frequencies.

The signal is old - at least a century - but the message is clear. The Chrysanthemum, the fifth Ulysses Initiative arkship, survived the scattering. The colonists found a world. They named it Unity.

The broadcast repeats: "Chrysanthemum colony to all Ulysses Initiative vessels. We have made landfall on a habitable world. The planet is beautiful. We are building something here. Come home."

The signal's origin cannot be determined from here, but the relay buoys used to carry it should be traceable. A survey of nearby systems may locate one.

风信子号舰队抵达中继星系
label.en: The Hyacinth fleet reaches the relay system

label.zh: 那都是陈年旧事了，记录下来，然后继续前进。
label.en: That's ancient history, log it and move on.

texts.zh: 联合星，我们终于有了关于秋菊号下落的线索。我们必须去看看我们的姐妹舰如今以何处为家。
texts.en: We finally have a lead on where the Chrysanthemum ended up, Unity. We must see where our sister ship now calls home.

texts.zh:
尤利西斯计划的一个中继浮标漂浮在这个星系中——破损不堪，勉强运转，但仍在发送广播。

除了最初的宣告外，浮标还载有两条后来的通讯。第二条的日期大约在第一条的十年后。

殖民地人口：二十六万。农业已建立。基础设施正在扩建。

第三条通讯的日期是第9182天——大约在登陆后的第二十五年。“我们还在这里。联合星的环境比最初的调查显示的更具挑战性。我们失去了一些同伴。如果有任何尤利西斯计划的飞船收到此广播，请回复。我们在这里。我们仍在坚持。”

联合星位于天津四星系，距离这里仅有几次超空间跳跃的航程。
texts.en:
A Ulysses Initiative relay buoy is drifting in this system - battered, barely functional, but still broadcasting.

Beyond the original announcement, the buoy carries two later transmissions. The second is dated roughly ten years after the first.

Colony population: two hundred and sixty thousand. Crops established. Infrastructure growing.

The third transmission is dated from Day 9,182 - approximately twenty-five years after landing. "We are still here. Unity is more challenging than initial surveys indicated. We have lost people. If any Ulysses Initiative vessel receives this broadcast, please respond. We are here. We endure."

Unity is in the Deneb system, only a few hyperlane jumps from here.

texts.zh:
天津四星系一片寂静。

“风信子”号脱离跃迁，发现没有信标，没有信号，也没有在星球间穿梭的飞船。奥林波斯星悬浮在半远处，庞大而冷漠。

有一颗卫星不对劲。殖民地的广播曾描述那里有绿色的大陆和广阔的水域，而扫描仪显示的却是一个死寂的世界——那是被核武器摧毁后的星球特有的无可错认的灰褐色。那里没有任何生命。

在近地轨道上，缓慢而暗淡地漂浮着的是“秋菊”号。它没有被毁。只是空无一人。每一扇舷窗都漆黑一片。这艘曾运载着二十五万殖民者来到这个世界的飞船，已经在这里停滞了数十年。
texts.en:
The Deneb system is quiet.

The Hyacinth drops from transit to find no beacons, no signals, no ships moving between worlds. Olympus hangs in the middle distance, enormous and indifferent.

One moon is wrong. Where the colony's broadcasts described green continents and open water, the scanners show a dead world - the unmistakable gray-brown of a nuked planet. Nothing lives there.

And in low orbit, drifting slow and dark, is the Chrysanthemum. Not destroyed. Simply empty. Every porthole dark. The ship that carried a quarter million colonists to this world has sat here for decades.

texts.zh: 联合星殖民地在失去联系前大约运作了二十五年。无论这里发生了什么，记录都保存了下来。殖民地的档案管理员一直坚持记录到了最后。
texts.en: The Unity colony operated for roughly twenty-five years before contact was lost. Whatever happened here, the record survived. The colony's archivist kept logging until the end.

sections.zh: 联合星殖民地在失去联系前大约运作了二十五年。无论这里发生了什么，记录都保存了下来。殖民地的档案管理员一直坚持记录到了最后。
sections.en: The Unity colony operated for roughly twenty-five years before contact was lost. Whatever happened here, the record survived. The colony's archivist kept logging until the end.

texts.zh:
殖民地的数据核心幸存了下来——被封存在玻璃化表岩屑下方的地下档案馆中。

第9251天：发现了一种新的掘地变种。外围墙体的防护等级不足以抵御地下突破。已向“秋菊”号请求工程支援。请求待批复。

第9389天：外环已撤离。地下居住区已确认安置了214,000名殖民者。部分区域失去联系。

第9441天：与7至12区的通讯中断。民兵伤亡：892人。

第9484天：地下四层的电力已中断。团队被要求停止记录。档案管理员予以拒绝。

第9514天：我们没有足够的时间了。
texts.en:
The colony's data cores survived - sealed in a subterranean archive beneath vitrified regolith.

Day 9,251: A new burrowing variant has been identified. The outer perimeter walls are not rated for subsurface breach. Engineering support requested from the Chrysanthemum. Request pending.

Day 9,389: Outer ring evacuated. 214,000 colonists accounted for in underground residential blocks. Some sectors uncontacted.

Day 9,441: Communications with sectors 7 through 12 lost. Militia casualties: 892.

Day 9,484: Power to sublevel four is gone. The team has been asked to stop logging. The archivist declines.

Day 9,514: We do not have enough time.

texts.zh:
议事厅是为容纳两百人而建造的。最后一次会议只召集到了十七人。档案员仍在进行记录。

会议持续了六个小时。共投出十二张选票——六票赞成轨道轰炸，六票反对。一名委员弃权。三人缺席；他们所在的防区三天前就已沦陷。

反对者争辩说，撤离仍然可行。“秋菊号”可以在地表殖民地的下层被攻破前分批撤离幸存者。

多数人则不这么认为。该生物已经到达了下层通道。任何停靠的飞船都会将污染带离这个星球。现在的选择已经不再是拯救部分人还是拯救所有人，而是失去一个世界，还是失去随后的每一个世界。

殖民地安全主管博克莱尔指挥官投下了决定性的一票。动议通过。殖民地宪章规定少数服从多数。那份宪章是他们在第一年亲自起草的，那时的未来看起来还是另一番光景。
texts.en:
The council chamber was built for two hundred. The final session convened seventeen people. The archivist was still logging.

The session ran for six hours. Twelve votes were cast - six for orbital bombardment, six against. One member abstained. Three were absent; their sectors had fallen three days prior.

The dissenters argued that evacuation was still possible. The Chrysanthemum could extract survivors in cycles before the lower levels were breached.

The majority held otherwise. The organism had already reached the lower access tunnels. Any vessel that docked would carry contamination offworld. The choice was no longer between saving some and saving all, but between losing one world and losing every world that followed.

Chief of Colony Security, Commander Beauclair, cast the deciding vote. The motion carried. The colony's charter said majority rules. They had written that charter themselves, in the first year, when the future looked different.

texts.zh:
舰桥日志始于第9516天——即投票两天后。

11名船员留下来确认地表清除情况。辐射水平。人口预估被下调，随后再次下调。第9519天：授权轰炸。第9521天：确认扇区清除完毕，40%。第9558天：地表已彻底净化。未探测到生命迹象。评估结果：全体一致。

船员们又花了四年时间进行天体物理学勘测。科学家们借此打发时间。

最后一篇日志的日期是第11204天。值班军官描述了一个晴朗的日子。她写道，在这么近的距离看天津四，与当初靠近它时所见的模样截然不同。记录到此结束。

最后的记录只有一个时间戳，没有歉意，也没有反思。仅仅是对星光的一句观察。
texts.en:
The bridge logs begin on Day 9,516 - two days after the vote.

Eleven crew remained to confirm surface clearance. Radiation levels. Population estimates revised downward, then revised again. Day 9,519: bombardment authorized. Day 9,521: sector clearance confirmed, 40%. Day 9,558: surface sterile. No life signatures detected. Assessment: unanimous.

The crew spent four more years on astrophysics surveys. Scientists filling the time.

The final log is dated Day 11,204. The officer on watch describes a clear day. She notes that Deneb looks different from this close than it did on approach. The entry ends there.

The final entry is a timestamp, no apology or reflection. Just an observation about starlight.

summary.text:
# 秋菊号的线索 / Clues of the Chrysanthemum

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · DLC: Nomads

## 如何开始 How it starts

游戏开始60–260天后（game_start.1），拥有 human_3 标记的玩家帝国收到“往日之声”nomads.9000：风信子号截获尤利西斯计划第五艘船“秋菊号”的旧求救信号（L17902-17935）。

At 60-260 days into the game (game_start.1), a player empire with the human_3 flag receives A Voice from the Past nomads.9000: the Hyacinth picks up an old distress call from the Chrysanthemum, the fifth Ulysses Initiative ship (L17902-17935).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

选择追踪信号后开启事件链：风信子号舰队到达中继星系发现浮标（“发现信号”9005），再前往天津四发现殖民地遗迹（“合一”9010），可创建考古遗址“联合星殖民地残骸”，三个阶段依次为“白热化”9015、“投票”9020、“日志”9025。

Following the signal starts the chain: the Hyacinth fleet finds the relay buoy (Signal Found 9005), then the colony remains at Deneb (Unity 9010), which can open the dig site Unity Colony Ruins with three stages: The Escalation 9015, The Vote 9020, The Logs 9025.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

在9000选择 b 只记录信号，不开启后续（事件链仍挂在帝国上，但没有舰队标记推进）。

Option b in 9000 only logs the signal (the chain is begun, but nothing advances it).
